title: Misima-Panaeati Language (MPX) – L1 & L2 Speakers, Status, Map, Endangered Level & Official Use | Ethnologue Free
text: Misima-Panaeati is a stable indigenous language of Papua New Guinea. It belongs to the Austronesian language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is used as a language of instruction in education.
